class.name: GIFTexture
class.brief_description: Texture2D subclass for displaying animated GIF images.
class.description: GIFTexture extends [Texture2D] to provide animated GIF support as a Godot resource. It decodes frames on demand and exposes them as [ImageTexture] objects. Assign it to a [TextureRect] to display [member frame], or to a [GIFPlayer] for automatic playback.

method.name: get_current_texture
method.description: Returns the [ImageTexture] for the currently selected frame.

method.name: get_frame_count
method.description: Returns the total number of frames in the GIF.

method.name: get_frame_delay
method.description: Returns the delay time in seconds for the specified frame.

method.name: get_frame_texture
method.description: Returns the [ImageTexture] for the specified frame index.

method.name: get_loop_count
method.description: Returns the loop count from the GIF metadata. 0 means infinite loop.

method.name: get_total_duration
method.description: Returns the total duration of the animation in seconds.

method.name: load_from_buffer
method.description: Static method to load a GIF from a memory buffer.

method.name: load_from_file
method.description: Static method to load a GIF from a file path.

members.member: The original bytes of the GIF file. Replacing the data resets [member frame] and clears cached metadata and decoded frames.
The zero-based index of the displayed frame. Use [GIFPlayer] for automatic playback or change this property to display a specific frame.
The cached number of frames in the GIF. This metadata is stored with the imported resource.
The cached delay for each frame in seconds, in frame index order. This metadata is stored with the imported resource.
The cached loop count from the GIF. [code]0[/code] means infinite repetition. This metadata is stored with the imported resource.
The cached GIF canvas size in pixels. This metadata is stored with the imported resource.
